rings.title: Evening Flock — Opposite tangents begin at three shared speeds
notes: The two rings start in the same places. Both flights have one-quarter usual speed, but their tangent directions oppose one another. The next beat still uses the ordinary local steering rules.
Both opposed tangents start at half usual speed. The initial sky positions are unchanged; this is a starting velocity, not a prescribed orbit or a slowed simulation clock.
Both opposed tangents start at twice usual speed. The ordinary force and speed caps still apply during later beats, so this does not promise a scaled copy of the slower trajectory.
